description: POI category names follow the rules locale of the map (de_AT) (#25941). 'Billa' is the brand and its 336 supermarkets, not the 748 water taps of the Galician 'Billa de auga'; 'Bank' is the banks, not the 20098 benches of the Swedish 'Bänk'; German phrases of the map name categories: 'Kino' cinemas, 'Sitzbank' benches; 'Paris' is only the shop named so. With the German map alone the whole name 'Fitness-Zentrum' (sports_centre) takes its words: 'Fitness Zentrum' is not the fitness stations of the English 'fitness', and in 'Sports Fitness Zentrum' the category is named by 'Fitness Zentrum' while 'sports' is a word of a name.
